subject: Proposed VP/CTO alignment: locking deep-dive window & pre-demo checklist
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Lee <ben.lee@acmehealth.io>, Aisha Tompkins <aisha.tompkins@acmehealth.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed VP/CTO alignment: locking deep-dive window & pre-demo checklist

Hi Ben / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and a proposed next step to get your CTO/VP looped in so we can unblock a technical pilot: 

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Primary objective: reduce inference latency for clinical summarization workflows and maintain PHI controls.
- Target throughput: ~200 concurrent sessions during business hours, 2–3k tokens/session median.
- Security asks: SSO (SAML), SOC 2 evidence, data residency / VPC requirement for protected data.
- Success metrics: 75% reduction in average token cost vs current on-prem baseline, P95 latency < 250ms for 256-token responses.

Proposed next step: VP/CTO handshake + technical deep dive to align infra, SSO, and contract gating items. Can we lock a 45–60 minute slot for a VP/CTO + technical run-through? I propose two windows next week (PT):
- Thu Apr 18, 11:00–12:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed Apr 17, 14:00–15:00 PT (backup)

Agenda (high level):
1) 10 min — Exec alignment (VP/CTO): business outcomes & SLAs
2) 30–40 min — Technical deep dive: runtime, caching, quantization options, network/VPC options
3) 10 min — Next steps: pilot gates, timeline, legal/PM contacts

Pre-demo asks (so we tailor the deep dive):
- Please share names of any infra/security folks who will join (SSO/contact for IdP).
- Any constraints around allowed cloud regions or on-prem hardware.
- A short sample prompt set you care about (if available).

I’ve attached a short pre-demo checklist to make scheduling productive. If the suggested windows don’t work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_pre-demo_checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks — I’ll coordinate calendars once you confirm which slot works and who will attend.

—Monica
Monica Patel

Ben / Aisha — thanks, Thu 11:00 PT is locked on our side. I’ll lead the technical portion and focus on the items you called out. Attachments and links below:

Attachments: [attachment: technical_runbook_v0.3.md (markdown)]
Pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-prep
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-HP-2029-042

Short runbook highlights (TL;DR):
- Integration surface: SAML SSO (IdP metadata exchange), optional VPC peering (AWS account IDs), and egress routing for protected data.
- Performance knobs we’ll demonstrate: dynamic KV caching for repeated prompts, 4-bit quantization profile for cost-sensitive models, and request multiplexing to reduce tail latency.
- Pilot deliverables: sample inference load test script, benchmark report template, and a 2-week pilot SLO draft.

If your security lead wants to review our SOC 2 artifacts ahead of the call, share a contact and we’ll provide an access link. Looking forward to Thursday — I’ll drop the calendar invite with the checklist and runbook attached.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
